title.narrative: Strengthening civic engagement to improve service delivery

description.narrative: To address governance problems that are undermining the delivery of basic services by strengthening civic engagement – the programme undertakes research to identify sectors (e.g. health) and areas with potential for change (e.g. maternal and child health issues), and then brings together state actors (from frontline workers to audit bodies) and non-state actors (from communities to civil society organisations) to discuss, agree and collaborate on cost-effective solutions (e.g. improve management of beneficiary feedback/grievance redress mechanisms) at the local and national level.
